Callout.Name: Grass Fire
Callout.Message: Grass fire on the hillside, wind picking up.
Callout.Advisory: No property at risk yet, walking trail nearby.

Script.Line: It started at the path and the wind has it now.
There are houses behind the ridge. They will not see it until it is on them.
Two of us have been beating it with coats. It is doing nothing.

Lines.Approach: Hillside, wind getting up, and there is a walking trail on the other side of it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
